_comment: The drinks list, from the Featured Cocktails card. Six built-to-order cocktails; wine and draft are handled at the bar rather than listed, so this file never goes stale against a rotating tap. Each drink carries an illustrated tile rather than a photograph — the real drinks were never shot, and drawn glassware is honest about that where a stock photo of somebody else's cocktail would not be. Swapping in real photography is one field per drink. No prices on the card we were given — the renderer omits the dotted leader when an item has none, so adding them later is one field per drink.
